subject: Observability add-ons pricing: retention / tracing / dashboards
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@altiusai.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@altiusai.com
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing / dashboards

Hi Jasmine,

We're putting together final pricing for our Q3 platform rollout and need a clear cost/packaging view for Redwood's observability add-ons: retention tiers (30/90/365), tracing (hotpath vs sampled), and the advanced dashboards package (seat-based vs seatless). Attached is a short RFP with our expected ingestion profile and the outcomes we're targeting.

Key asks:
- A one-page price matrix for each add-on (monthly cost for the listed tiers).
- Any available pilot/POC concession for a 3-month proof (we have a short procurement window).
- Clarity on how overages are billed for retention and tracing; does caching impact billing?
- Estimated timeline and a draft SOW for a 6-week pilot.

We're also sensitive to the dashboard seat fees — if there's a model to exchange seats for a higher ingestion slab or commit, please outline it.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Director, Platform Engineering
AltiusAI

Attachment: Altius_RFP.pdf (1.2 MB)
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@altiusai.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing / dashboards

Hi Lena — thanks for the RFP and the clear asks. Looping in Ben (pricing) and Kimberly (commercial/enterprise). We'll put together a compact matrix and a short pilot SOW you can share with procurement.

Quick clarifications before we build the sheet:
- For retention: do you anticipate relatively stable ingestion (no spikes) or periodic bursts from batch jobs? That affects the recommended slab vs. pay-as-you-go.
- For tracing: When you say hotpath vs sampled, is hotpath coverage expected for <1% latency-sensitive traces or a broader 5–10% slice?

I'll propose an internal call tomorrow morning (short) to align on the offers and concessions so we can send a crisp package by Friday.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Observability add-ons: retention / tracing / dashboards — draft pricing thoughts

Jasmine / Kimberly — notes from my quick pass. Attaching a draft price worksheet and a one-page commercial note.

Highlights / proposed structure:
- Retention: three standard slabs (30d, 90d, 365d). Recommend quoting slab prices + a 10% overage rate that charges per GB-month beyond the slab. Overage billing triggered daily, rounded to nearest GB.
- Tracing: two modes — sampled (metered at 0.002 $/span equivalent) and hotpath (flat slab priced by peak TPS tier). Hotpath should include a small reserve to avoid sudden surcharges; propose a 15% buffer on peak TPS for the pilot.
- Dashboards: two packaging options:
  * Seat-based (per-seat/month) with a lower ingestion allowance included per seat.
  * Seatless project slab priced by ingestion and widgets; recommended for orgs that want self-serve dashboards for many non-technical users.

Pilot concession ideas:
- 3-month pilot: 50% off retention slab (first three months), waived setup fee, and a one-time $2k credit toward dashboard seats.
- Conditional on a 6–9 month renewal commitment after pilot to qualify for the discounts.

Tradeoffs / asks for Altius input:
- If they can commit to a minimum monthly ingestion (GB/mo) during the pilot, we can be more aggressive on the seat fee.
- Need clarity on their expected peak TPS for hotpath traces.

Attachments: pricing_spreadsheet.xlsx, Redwood_SOW_v3.docx

Ben
Head of Commercial, Redwood Inference
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@altiusai.com>, Devon Lowe <devon.lowe@altiusai.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, procurement@altiusai.com
Date: Sat, 17 May 2025 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposal: add-on pricing matrix + short pilot SOW

Hi Lena / Devon — thanks for the patience. Attached are two artifacts: a concise pricing matrix (by add-on and tier) and a 6-week pilot SOW that reflects the concession Ben proposed. Summary below.

Executive summary (short):
- Retention: 30d / 90d / 365d slabs priced in the matrix. Pilot: 50% off retention slab pricing for the pilot period; overages billed at $0.12 / GB-month (daily measurement).
- Tracing: sampled at $0.002/span-eq (metered). Hotpath available as a peak-TPS slab; for the pilot we recommend the mid-tier slab with a 15% reserved buffer to avoid throttles.
- Dashboards: two routes — seat-based ($30 / seat / month) with an included 250GB ingestion allowance per seat, or seatless project slab (starts at $6k / month). Pilot credit: one-time $2k dashboard credit.

Pilot terms (6 weeks):
- Waived setup fee, 50% retention discount for pilot months, $2k dashboard credit, and a scoped support SLA.
- Conditional follow-on: a 6–9 month post-pilot commit with standard commercial terms to retain the discounts.

Next steps:
1) If this package looks sensible, procurement can sign the attached SOW and we can route for DocuSign (link below).
2) If procurement needs price variance, Ben asked for a minimum ingestion commitment (GB/mo) during the pilot in order to increase the dashboard seat concession.

DocuSign (proposal + SOW): https://app.docusign.com/s/EXAMPLE-DocuSign-Link
HubSpot: HS-112233

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-minute call to walk the SOW and the invoice cadence.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_spreadsheet.xlsx, Redwood_SOW_v3.docx
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@altiusai.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@altiusai.com, Devon Lowe <devon.lowe@altiusai.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: add-on pricing matrix + short pilot SOW

Jasmine — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear tradeoffs. Procurement asked for two small asks before we sign the SOW:

1) Can you reduce the dashboard per-seat fee to $24 / seat / month for the pilot period, or alternatively increase the included ingestion per seat to 400GB?
2) For the retention overage rate, can you cap monthly overages at 20% of the slab price for the pilot (to give us billing predictability)?

If you can confirm either concession, procurement will route the SOW for signature this week. Otherwise we'll need to re-run a quick internal approval loop.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

— Lena
Director, Platform Engineering
AltiusAI
